sample_knowledge_items.title: [SYNTHETIC] Lab Fisika Dasar Safety & Attire Policy
sample_knowledge_items.content_raw: All students enrolled in Physics Practicum must wear closed-toe leather shoes and a standard white lab coat with university emblem. Food and sweetened drinks are prohibited inside Lab B-201. Pre-lab report submissions are due at 07:45 AM sharp.

sample_knowledge_items.title: [SYNTHETIC] Pomodoro Technique for Programming Practicals
sample_knowledge_items.content_raw: When debugging complex pointer structures or asynchronous functions, break sessions into 25-minute focused blocks followed by a 5-minute break. This prevents mental fatigue and reduces syntax errors.
